INSERT INTO attempt_events (attempt_id, sequence, command_id, kind, actor, actor_id, client_occurred_at, payload, id) VALUES ($1::UUID, $2::INTEGER, $3::UUID, $4::VARCHAR, $5, $6::UUID, $7::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $8::JSONB, $9::UUID) RETURNING attempt_events.occurred_at
UPDATE attempts SET settings_snapshot=$1::JSONB WHERE attempts.id = $2::UUID
